elevation.$description: Composite box-shadows for floating/overlay UI (Tooltip, Popover, Drawer, Modal, Menu, Listbox) — NOT general surfaces (those separate with an outline hairline). Renamed from the old `shadow` primitive to free the `shadow` name for the semantic shadow-colour group. Colour is the page colour (surface-0, rgba(17,20,28,…)) at higher alpha than a light theme would use — a dark UI needs a heavier shadow to read as 'lifted', and these panels also sit over a scrim (surface.overlay) or the page. Three steps for the three floating weights.

sm.$description: Popover/Tooltip/Menu/Listbox — small panels anchored to a trigger, least visual weight.

md.$description: Drawer — a full-height edge panel, one step more prominent.

lg.$description: Modal — the most prominent floating surface (paired with its own dedicated scrim), strongest shadow. Small negative spread keeps the 24px blur from reading as a diffuse haze.
